name: Image Extractor
summary: Extract and download all images from any webpage.
detail: Fetches a webpage and extracts every embedded image. Displays them in a gallery and lets you bulk-download. Useful for archiving photo evidence from websites.
howTo: Enter the URL of the target webpage
Click Extract

name: Link Gopher
summary: Browser extension that extracts all links from a webpage.
detail: Firefox/Chrome extension that collects all hyperlinks from the current page and displays them in a sortable, filterable list. Export to text. Good for mapping a site's external link profile.
howTo: Install the extension from your browser's store
Navigate to the target page

name: Privacy Guides
summary: Curated, up-to-date recommendations for privacy tools and practices.
detail: Community-maintained guide to privacy-respecting tools. Covers browsers, VPNs, email providers, messaging apps, password managers, and more. All recommendations are independently vetted.
howTo: Browse categories relevant to your operational needs
Read the criteria used to evaluate each tool

name: ExifTool
summary: Read, write, and strip metadata from any file type.
detail: The definitive tool for metadata analysis and removal. Supports 200+ file formats. Read EXIF data from images (GPS, camera, timestamp), edit or strip metadata before sharing files.
howTo: Install: brew install exiftool
Read metadata: exiftool image.jpg
proTip: Always strip metadata from images before sharing in research reports. GPS coordinates embedded in phone photos can revea…

name: Image Scrubber
summary: Browser-based tool to blur faces and strip EXIF from images.
detail: Open-source browser tool that lets you pixelate or blur faces/identifying details in photos and strip all EXIF metadata. Runs entirely client-side — images never leave your browser.
howTo: Upload the image
Use the brush tool to paint over faces or identifying info

name: Metacleaner
summary: Web-based metadata remover for documents and images.
detail: Upload PDF, Office documents, or images and strip all embedded metadata. Useful when you need a quick clean without installing ExifTool.
howTo: Upload your file
Click Clean Metadata

name: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Online Anonymity
summary: Comprehensive operational security guide for researchers.
detail: Detailed, regularly updated guide covering threat modeling, anonymous identities, VMs, Tor, VPNs, operational security hygiene, and advanced anonymity techniques. Community maintained and free.
howTo: Read from the beginning if new to OPSEC
Jump to specific chapters for targeted guidance

name: Counter-OSINT Guide
summary: How targets protect themselves — essential reading for investigators.
detail: Explains every technique people use to minimize their digital footprint. Understanding defensive techniques makes you a better investigator. Written in Russian with English translation available.
howTo: Read through to understand what privacy-conscious subjects do
Use this knowledge to know what data may be deliberately missing

name: Signal
summary: Gold standard end-to-end encrypted messaging and calls.
detail: Open-source, audited end-to-end encryption for messages, calls, and video. No metadata stored. Disappearing messages. Used by journalists, activists, and security researchers worldwide.
howTo: Download Signal for iOS/Android/Mac
Register with a phone number (use a Google Voice number for operational separation)

name: The Tor Project
summary: Anonymizing network — routes traffic through three encrypted relays.
detail: Routes internet traffic through three volunteer-run encrypted relays, making it difficult to trace back to the originating IP. Download the Tor Browser for the easiest entry point.
howTo: Download Tor Browser from the official site (verify the signature)
Launch Tor Browser — it connects automatically
proTip: Combine Tor with a VPN only if you understand the trust implications. VPN over Tor hides Tor use from your ISP. Tor over…

name: ProtonVPN
summary: Swiss-based VPN with a verified no-logs policy and free tier.
detail: No-logs VPN based in Switzerland. Free tier includes unlimited bandwidth (with speed limits) on three countries. Paid tiers add more servers and Secure Core (double-hop routing).
howTo: Download ProtonVPN for macOS
Create a Proton account (free or paid)

name: Jitsi Meet
summary: End-to-end encrypted video calls — no account needed.
detail: Open-source video conferencing with no account required. Just create a room name and share the link. End-to-end encryption available. Self-hostable.
howTo: Go to meet.jit.si
Type a unique room name (make it random, not guessable)

name: IntelTechniques Tools
summary: Michael Bazzell's comprehensive OSINT search tool collection.
detail: A curated collection of custom search tools for people, usernames, email, phone, social media, and more. Each tool aggregates multiple sources into a single interface. Industry standard for investigat…
howTo: Browse the tool index by category
Open the relevant tool (e.g., People Search, Email Search)
proTip: Michael Bazzell's podcast 'Privacy, Security, & OSINT Show' provides context and updates for these tools.

name: SynapsInt
summary: Unified OSINT search across IP, domain, email, username, and phone.
detail: Single interface that queries multiple OSINT databases for a given identifier. Paste an IP, domain, email, username, or phone number and get aggregated results from dozens of sources.
howTo: Select the entity type from the top menu
Enter the target identifier

name: OSINT.SH
summary: Suite of free browser-based OSINT tools — subdomains, WHOIS, OCR, and more.
detail: Collection of free in-browser OSINT tools: subdomain finder, reverse WHOIS, reverse IP, DNS history, certificate search, port scanner, email finder, and OCR. No account needed.
howTo: Browse the tool list on the homepage
Select the relevant tool

name: Intelligence X
summary: Search engine for leaked data, Tor, and dark web sources.
detail: Indexes paste sites, data dumps, darkweb forums, Tor hidden services, and public sources. Search by email, domain, IP, CIDR, URL, or keyword. Free tier is limited but useful for quick checks.
howTo: Enter the search term (email, domain, IP, etc.)
Select the search type from the dropdown

name: Criminal IP
summary: AI-powered cyber threat intelligence search engine.
detail: Shodan alternative with a focus on threat scoring and malicious infrastructure detection. Scans and indexes IP addresses, domains, and certificates. Provides a risk score for each asset.
howTo: Search by IP address, domain, or keyword
Review the risk score and associated threat categories

name: IDCrawl
summary: People search engine aggregating social profiles, usernames, and phone records.
detail: Searches name, username, email, and phone across social networks, public records, and people directories. Returns a unified profile view. US-focused but covers some international data.
howTo: Enter full name with state/city for best results
Review the results list for matching records

name: TruePeopleSearch
summary: Free US people finder — addresses, relatives, and phone numbers.
detail: Comprehensive US public records aggregator. Completely free, no account needed. Returns current and historical addresses, associated phone numbers, and relatives — making it excellent for network mapp…
howTo: Search by full name + state, or by phone number, or by address
Review the address history for a timeline of residences
proTip: The reverse address search is powerful — enter an address to find all residents associated with it over time.

name: WebMii
summary: Aggregates public web presence — social, news, and web mentions.
detail: Searches for a person across the web and aggregates results with a 'visibility score'. Good for initial digital footprint assessment. Pulls from news, social media, and public web pages.
howTo: Enter first and last name
Optionally add a keyword to narrow (e.g., company name)

name: PeekYou
summary: Links username, social, and web profiles into a unified person record.
detail: Aggregates a person's digital footprint by linking username, social media, web presence, and public records. Useful for finding all online accounts associated with a real-world identity.
howTo: Search by full name (optionally add username or location)
Review the consolidated profile
